name_reason: Name is fully compliant and accurate. Prefix data_fd2_ (game global) + battle_ (summon animation is a battle subsystem, consistent with sibling symbols data_fd2_battle_summon_* in anisummn.c) + summon_anim_ domain + variant_d_ (variant-D summon animation = dispatch-table entry #7, fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot; the 'd' is a variant family label, NOT a Ghidra address residue) + odd_even_frame_toggle (reflects the mod-2 toggle/flag data type and its even-frame-gate role). No address-residue suffix.
purpose: uint8 mod-2 odd/even frame toggle for the variant-D 3-slot summon animation; gates the even-frame state updates (frame advance, SFX, color rotation) so they run only every other tick.
logic_summary: uint8 zero-bss runtime scratch (on-disk 0x00), used only by fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot (0x272B8, dispatch entry #7). INIT (state_code 0) clears it (MOV byte ptr [0x540B9],0 @0x27340) before any read this run. Each tick path (state_code 2/5/8) does INC byte ptr [0x540B9] @0x27389, reads it back (MOVZX EDX,byte ptr [0x540B9] @0x2738F) feeding IDIV by 2 (EBX=2 @0x27396) and writes the remainder (MOV byte ptr [0x540B9],DL @0x273A2), so the value stays 0..1. It is then read (MOVZX EAX,byte ptr [0x540B9] @0x2746D, TEST/JNZ) as the even-frame gate: when zero, the per-slot frame advance / frame-1 SFX / frame-7 color-rotation block runs; when one, only the blit-if-visible step runs. All access byte-wide and unsigned.
element_semantics: Single mod-2 toggle byte. Cleared to 0 at INIT, flipped 0<->1 each tick via (x+1)%2 (compiled INC then IDIV-by-2 remainder). Value 0 = even frame (enable per-slot state updates), 1 = odd frame (skip them).
notes: Verified every claim against the disassembly of fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot: INIT clear @0x27340; state-guard CMP 2/5/8 @0x27376-0x27383; INC @0x27389; MOVZX read-back @0x2738F; IDIV by 2 (EBX=2) @0x27396-0x273A0; remainder store @0x273A2; even-frame gate read MOVZX @0x2746D + TEST/JNZ @0x27474-0x27476. xrefs_to 0x540B9 = WRITE @0x27340, READ_WRITE @0x27389, READ @0x2738F, WRITE @0x273A2, READ @0x2746D -- all inside fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot, no other accessor. is_const=false: written every tick (INC + mod-2 store) and at INIT. read_memory shows on-disk image 0x00 (zero-bss). Ghidra data PLATE_COMMENT was empty (null); created it via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) with a concise summary consistent with the src comment (src lines 203-220, which were already accurate -> comment_verdict=keep, src not edited). Datatype byte in Ghidra matches uint8.
